svg.title: 20x connects task sources, coding harnesses, and context
svg.desc: Task source logos: Linear, GitHub Issues, HubSpot, Notion, GitLab, YouTrack, Peakflo Workflo, and manual entry. Their tasks enter the 20x workspace. Harness logos: Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Cursor, and Pi. Repositories, skills, MCP servers, and browser panels provide context.
svg.text: The task stays at the center.
Canvas keeps linked work and browser context
Work log, approvals, and result return here
